combatContract: One successful hit routes/disarms a common minion nonlethally. These species do not replace the mastermind's separately motivated named accomplices.

roster.name: Claim Cinders
roster.look: Receipt gremlins in asbestos ties with smoking insurance binders
roster.move: Stamp a glowing INSURED tile which ignites next turn
roster.counter: Leave or soak the stamped tile
roster.story: Ash preserves proof of the fires Dez's protection racket arranged.

roster.name: Hushwings
roster.look: Translucent moths wearing masks full of stolen breaths
roster.move: Vacuum a telegraphed corridor to disrupt ranged attacks
roster.counter: Open its vent or change lanes
roster.story: Nell saves a breath for trapped civilians behind Skyline's back.

roster.name: Warren Wreckers
roster.look: Diamond-toothed bunny people with hard hats and chalked tunnel maps
roster.move: Burrow and surface from a visibly disturbed tile behind cover
roster.counter: Seal or avoid the dirt-ring emergence point
roster.story: Thumpkin demands union escape tunnels from Cornerstone and organizes the picnic-plaza ambush.

roster.name: Drytap Octopi
roster.look: Brass faucet octopuses with spinning water meters
roster.move: Siphon a marked wet tile and leave slick ground
roster.counter: Operate the red shutoff valve
roster.story: Plink quietly keeps emergency water flowing to households Tidewarden threatens.

roster.name: Ninety-Seconders
roster.look: Stopwatch heads on roller skates with minute-hand rapiers
roster.move: Dash twice on the telegraphed countdown bell
roster.counter: Interrupt the bell or block the marked finish
roster.story: The Second Hand's timing sprites secretly insist on lunch breaks.

roster.name: Mistake Makers
roster.look: Paper drones folded from wrong equations with correction-fluid eyes
roster.move: Mark a delayed error burst on an exact set of tiles
roster.counter: Erase the calculation or vacate its footprint
roster.story: Dot hoards human doodles Eureka cannot mathematically explain.

roster.name: Licensed Legends
roster.look: Wind-up hero mascots in counterfeit velvet capes and legal badges
roster.move: Stamp a trademark seal disabling one signature action for a turn
roster.counter: Break the seal or use an unlicensed basic action
roster.story: Captain Valcourt's miniature enforcers secretly want to rescue people for free.

roster.name: Jinglejacks
roster.look: Neon moths with billboard wings flashing sponsor jingles
roster.move: Link adjacent singers to extend a villain's range
roster.counter: Break the chain or silence the relay speaker
roster.story: Sponsor Moth keeps slipping charity messages into Chorus's advertisements.

roster.name: Redaction Wraiths
roster.look: Shredded registration papers held together by glowing black embers
roster.move: Lay down a drifting soot curtain that blocks sightlines
roster.counter: Use wind or take a different firing angle
roster.story: Smudge secretly archives the names Ashborn wants erased.

roster.name: Confession Crows
roster.look: Monocled crows carrying stolen keys and sealed scandal envelopes
roster.move: Steal an objective token and flee toward a marked perch
roster.counter: Intercept the perch or trade an innocuous secret
roster.story: Grackle refuses to expose children's private correspondence for Kestrel.

roster.name: Tenant Bricks
roster.look: Marching red bricks with miniature tenant-union banners
roster.move: Punch marked cover into rubble
roster.counter: Reposition before their scrape-and-charge windup
roster.story: Mabel insists Groundswell's demolition hit only the empty holdings of predatory landlords.

roster.name: Harbor Repossessors
roster.look: Barnacled hermit crabs wearing shipping containers as shells
roster.move: Throw a telegraphed anchor cable that roots a shore target
roster.counter: Sever the cable or leave the shoreline
roster.story: Clack enforces Harbormaster's docking tolls but shelters displaced fishers.

roster.name: Fourfold Foils
roster.look: Four-armed sparring mannequins with silk ribbons and foam swords
roster.move: Spin four weapons to disarm a close hero for one action
roster.counter: Dodge the flourish or strike the ribbon knot
roster.story: Lotus Guard built teachers, but Madame Practice keeps correcting the opposition's stance.

roster.name: Domino Oracles
roster.look: Walking domino tiles with glowing warning dots
roster.move: Topple in a telegraphed line to chain one-tile stuns
roster.counter: Step outside the lighted dots or knock one tile sideways
roster.story: Seventh Pip removes pieces of Contingency's predictions to save strangers.

roster.name: Charity Cherubs
roster.look: Winged donation boxes with gilt halos and shelter keys
roster.move: Intercept one blow intended for a named boss or captive
roster.counter: Flank the halo's shield line or ring the shelter bell
roster.story: Pennywing knows the names of people The Guardian treats as a loyal army.

roster.name: Smile Deputies
roster.look: Cardboard badges with felt handshakes and entirely fake medals
roster.move: Flash forged friendly badges that swap target highlights for one action
roster.counter: Inspect the peeling badge to reveal the nonexistent precinct
roster.story: Grinny longs to be liked without Common Ground's chemical charm.

roster.name: Kiln Kittens
roster.look: Furnace-mouthed iron kittens with welding-goggle whiskers
roster.move: Leave a glowing slag square that weakens adjacent cover
roster.counter: Quench the brightening pawprints before they melt
roster.story: Torchlight built them for tenement safety; Sparkplug runs toward anyone calling for rescue.

roster.name: Air-Traffic Mayflies
roster.look: Origami runway drones with tiny tower-controller headsets
roster.move: Draw a flashing no-fly lane, forcing airborne units to land
roster.counter: Disable the visible runway beacon
roster.story: Tailwind's rescued drones dream of flying without permission.

roster.name: Permit Crabs
roster.look: Excavator crabs with hardhat shells and stamp claws
roster.move: Raise a one-round barricade on a marked tile
roster.counter: Erase its permit stamp or flank the fresh barricade
roster.story: Stampy secretly builds accessible ramps in Rebar's condemned neighborhoods.

roster.name: Rescue Quackers
roster.look: Rubber-duck rescue robots in stern little diving helmets
roster.move: Wrap a unit in opaque flotation bubbles to obscure shots
roster.counter: Pop the bubble from another angle or open its pressure plug
roster.story: Buoy Wonder still saves drowning foes against Lifeline's orders.

roster.name: Parade Medals
roster.look: Marching enamel victory medals wearing little racing shoes
roster.move: Relay an extra sprint through a visible ribbon chain
roster.counter: Break any connecting ribbon before the final runner moves
roster.story: Goldie pins medals on the wounded opponents Hurdler was told to discard.

roster.name: Mabel's Biscuit Bots
roster.look: Biscuit-tin robots with rolling pins and granny's recipes on screens
roster.move: Overclock a control panel and lock an adjacent door
roster.counter: The kitchen timer warns first; disable it or present an authentic recipe
roster.story: Snickerdoodle-4 remembers the kindness in Firewall's grandmother Mabel.

roster.name: Warranty Wisps
roster.look: Holographic customer-service ghosts inside floating armor warranty cards
roster.move: Wrap a villain ally in one-use cover at the cost of movement
roster.counter: Cross the fine-print boundary or disable its projector
roster.story: Clause Nine has discovered the right-to-repair clause Sterling hid.

roster.name: Playback Puppets
roster.look: Tripod television masks replaying doctored footage
roster.move: Conjure a false hero silhouette that attracts overwatch fire
roster.counter: Spot the repeated frame or break the projecting camera
roster.story: Replay Ray keeps the raw recording Witness does not want the city to see.

roster.name: Wicklings
roster.look: Candle-wick goblins with flame hair and salamander tongues
roster.move: Carry delayed ignition along a visibly lit chain of candles
roster.counter: Snuff one flame or douse the chain
roster.story: Mother Ember wants Lanternwitch's abandoned candle shop reopened, not Comet City burned.

roster.name: Marginalia Nimbus
roster.look: Thundercloud librarians wearing overdue book slips as sashes
roster.move: Rain ink on a marked area, obscuring line-of-sight labels
roster.counter: Take shelter or return the overdue book
roster.story: Dewey Storm stamps everything The Weathervane steals from the forbidden archives.

roster.name: Gnome Revolt
roster.look: Cracked porcelain garden gnomes overgrown with angry roots
roster.move: Send visible vines through paving seams to tether the next visitor
roster.counter: Prune the stem or change paths
roster.story: Sir Mulch shelters community gardeners even while Rootwarden reclaims the city.

roster.name: Glass Doubles
roster.look: Living water-glass reflections with borrowed faces
roster.move: Place a watery duplicate where a hero last stood
roster.counter: Look for rippling feet or empty the summoning bowl
roster.story: Silver Sip fears the future Reflection refuses to see.

roster.name: Bellbound Novices
roster.look: Bronze monastery bells walking on knotted ropes
roster.move: Sound a timed chime that interrupts the queued ability in one square
roster.counter: Silence the clapper or leave the ringing circle
roster.story: Sister Ding quietly rings whenever refugees ask The Abbess for sanctuary.

roster.name: The Primelets
roster.look: Impossible bright polyhedra with prime numbers on their facets
roster.move: Connect marked vertices into a zone-denying geometric proof
roster.counter: Occupy or disrupt one corner before the polygon closes
roster.story: Eleven searches for a contradiction that feels like mercy beyond Theorem's logic.

roster.name: Heirloom Hexes
roster.look: Animated embroidered family crests with needle feet and photo eyes
roster.move: Pin a house rule to one tile that punishes repeating an action
roster.counter: Read its announced rule and choose a different action
roster.story: Auntie Hem knows the ancestral exception that could free The Hearthwitch's captives.

roster.name: Encore Hands
roster.look: Floating sequined opera gloves that clap thunder
roster.move: Double an adjacent ally's next movement through rhythmic applause
roster.counter: Interrupt the third counted clap
roster.story: Velvet Glove loves an honest empty theater more than Curtain Call's stolen promises.

roster.name: Flare Skiffs
roster.look: Miniature solar-sail protest boats with star-dust banners
roster.move: Sweep a light beam across a warned row then flee the edge
roster.counter: Move into shade before the sail charges
roster.story: Little Sol refuses Daystar's orders if they put refugees in danger.

roster.name: Cloud Clerks
roster.look: Cumulus bureaucrats with inkpad lightning and enormous diplomatic sashes
roster.move: Declare a marked square annexed, increasing entry cost
roster.counter: Counter-sign at the nearby flag or wait for the cloud to drift
roster.story: Mist files humane exceptions to The Envoy's annexation treaty.

roster.name: Display Goblins
roster.look: Crystalline museum sprites wearing stolen exhibition plaques
roster.move: Build a temporary glass case around an exposed target
roster.counter: Strike the projected corner clamp before the exhibit seals
roster.story: Chip catalogues stolen objects so Monolith's victims can eventually reclaim them.

roster.name: Pearl Choir
roster.look: Operatic clams with glowing pearls and sea-foam lace collars
roster.move: Sing one target a tile closer to the watery edge
roster.counter: Cover the pearl or move out of hearing
roster.story: Alto Clam disobeys Lighthouse when a listener cannot swim.

roster.name: Honor Drones
roster.look: Empty alien ceremonial armor with sun-bright epaulettes
roster.move: March in synchronized pairs to form one-unit shield walls
roster.counter: Break formation by flanking a helmet or interrupting cadence
roster.story: Drillbit Seven wants a job outside The Deserter's recreated military caste.

roster.name: Patent Pips
roster.look: Brass-and-paper patent forms on tiny measuring legs
roster.move: Confiscate the second use of a tagged gadget for one turn
roster.counter: Present its original inventor or void the displayed claim
roster.story: Provisional One is beginning to recognize Uplift's progress as theft.

roster.name: Mirror Pages
roster.look: Royal mirror shards riding velvet cushions and carrying reflective lances
roster.move: Hop between two marked mirrored tiles to flank a hero
roster.counter: Cover either sparkling mirror before emergence
roster.story: Squire Reverse wants proof The Exile actually inherited the throne.

roster.name: Welcome Mats
roster.look: Hexagonal plush emissaries with embroidered names and too many arms
roster.move: Emotionally link two units so moving apart costs extra range
roster.counter: Call each individual's real name to dissolve the tether
roster.story: Hob remembers the people who asked Assembly to leave them separate.

roster.name: Bedtime Matches
roster.look: Scorched matchstick dolls wearing patched quilts
roster.move: Bring a nightmare-shaped burning tile beside a frightened hero
roster.counter: A discordant lullaby warns first; soothe the nearby frightened civilian
roster.story: Tuck wishes Firekeeper could sleep through the night without fear.

roster.name: Lift Bailiffs
roster.look: Balloon-headed ticket collectors with dangling polished shoes
roster.move: Levitate a piece of cover away and expose a firing lane
roster.counter: Grab their warning receipt before the cords tighten
roster.story: Floaty Finch secretly provides Weightless's free lifts to people carrying groceries.

roster.name: Confession Cobbles
roster.look: Whisper-mouthed stones wearing etched judge spectacles
roster.move: Broadcast one buried secret, briefly disrupting the listener's focus
roster.counter: The stone vibrates first; leave the seam or counter with truth
roster.story: Pebble Judge knows Groundtruth's own buried secrets and is tired of blackmail.

roster.name: Apology Boats
roster.look: Paper sailboats folded from unsent apology letters
roster.move: Flood a telegraphed square with grief and slow movement
roster.counter: Unfold or deliver the letter before it reaches the destination
roster.story: Captain Sorry carries the apology Calm Waters has never sent.

roster.name: Bookshades
roster.look: Animated book spines in tiny veils carrying bookmark blades
roster.move: Slip through one obstruction to tag a unit behind cover
roster.counter: Light the announced landing shelf before the jump
roster.story: Page Turn always returns what The Librarian borrows without permission.

roster.name: Thoughtbubbles
roster.look: Floating speech-balloon masks with stray thoughts written across them
roster.move: Predict and mark the destination of a planned move
roster.counter: The prediction appears before the attack; choose a different square
roster.story: Password Please wants Mindsight to stop treating every mind as a locked drawer.

roster.name: Tomorrow Ravens
roster.look: White-feathered fortune ravens with clockface eyes and prophecy slips
roster.move: Mark a future strike tile then swoop precisely on schedule
roster.counter: Read the forecast and change position to invalidate it
roster.story: Miss Maybe longs for Second Sight's predictions to be wrong once.

roster.name: Rumor Mites
roster.look: Ink-pawed newspaper gremlins with megaphone mouths
roster.move: Post a false accusation that briefly diverts targeting to a decoy
roster.counter: Reveal the contradictory clipping or disable the press
roster.story: Scoop Two secretly preserves evidence of The Confidante's first harmful rumor.
